scope: standalone Cell CPU; immutable guard kernels integrated into serial runtime

concurrency_evidence.unit_fixture: Two scoped worker threads share one condition, port bindings and equality relation; each returns its own counts.
concurrency_evidence.runtime_graph_fixture: Three scoped worker threads evaluate borrowed live-Graph key candidates, rejecting wrong operator/scalar keys without changing Graph counters.
concurrency_evidence.type_checks: ReadView, KeyGuard and the immutable condition Plan satisfy Send + Sync without unsafe implementations.
concurrency_evidence.lifetime_fixture: A new borrow sees a union through the unchanged port; hidden peers remain eligible and deleted/expired instances are rejected.

limits: Executor still calls the kernels serially. Scoped worker execution is verified in fixtures, not integrated worker scheduling. The borrow prevents Graph mutation during reading; there is no asynchronous generation protocol or multithreaded speedup claim.
remaining: Batch useful guard/query work without copying Graph or scanning unrelated tables; schedule ready work on persistent workers, preserve candidate/publication order, and account for dispatch, result buffers, allocations and contention before performance admission.
